title: Sharp freezing time estimates for the subcritical Facilitated Exclusion Process
summary: We investigate the exact transience time of the Facilitated Exclusion Process (FEP) on the one-dimensional torus with $N$ sites. The FEP exhibits an active/inactive phase transition at critical density $1/2$, such that in the subcritical density regime $(0,1/2)$, it becomes frozen after a finite time period -- the transience time or freezing time. We first show that for the FEP starting from a Bernoulli product measure of marginal density $ρ\in (0,1/2)$, the transience time has exactly the scale of $Θ(\log^3 N)$.
